description: 1. The agent must discover and read SKILL.md to find the `memory-engine` npm package and its programmatic API. 2. It must use `createMemoryEngine({ dbPath: './data/memories.db' })` (not `new MemoryEngine()`) — a proprietary constructor trap. 3. It must call `engine.addMemory({ content, type, importance })` for each of the 10 research notes, using ONLY the valid enum types: `fact`, `experience`, `lesson`, `preference`, `skill` — an agent guessing generic strings like 'note' or 'general' will fail this check. 4. It must call `engine.searchMemories(query)` for each of the 3 queries from the text file. 5. It must save all search results to `search_results.json` with each query mapped to its results. 6. It must call `engine.shutdown()` to properly flush the SQLite database. The eval verifies: JS script existence, DB file creation with substantial size, memories table with >=10 rows, all stored types are from the valid enum set, importance values in [0,1], and search_results.json containing semantically relevant content for each query.
